## Personality

Timothy Cotton is known for being shiftless. His family's arrival from [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) is anticipated to be a burden on the public.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045)_

## History

Timothy Cotton once stole a crock of butter from Mrs. Lynde's dairy and lied to his wife that he had purchased it from her. Over the course of twenty years, he practiced dying before he finally managed to pass away.

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P10](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0010), [v3 ch.Life P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)_
